### 14.

Strabōn, biblion 15, selis 692: peri tou bosmorou, hon Onesikritos phēsi siton einai pyrou elattō, phuomenon de en tois metaxy tōn potamōn chōriois. phrygetai de thēomenos, kai horkous lambanousin hoi anthrōpoi mē ekkomizein auton ek tēs halōos aphrygton, hina mē ekpempētai to sperma.
paraballe Diodoron, biblion 2, kephalaion 36, hopou ta biblia tēn graphēn "bosporon" deiknysin. hora ton Stephanou Thēsauron hypo "bosmoron." — "sitos": houtō phēsin ho tēs Epitomēs syngrapheus; ta de tou Strabōnos antigrapha "sēpton" phēsin.

### 15.

Strabōn, biblion 15, selis 694: hē India polla kai thaumasta phuei dendra, hōn hen esti tōn klōnōn katōneuein echon, ta de phylla ouk elattō aspidos. Onesikritos de, akribesteron peri tēs Mousikanou chōras dialegomenos, hēn phēsi notiōtatēn einai tēs Indikēs, perigraphe dendra tina megala, hōn hoi klōnes anō phuontai epi dōdeka pēcheis, epeita to loipon tēs auxēseōs katōneuousin, hōsper kamphthenta, mechri an tē gē prosapsōntai. epeita, dia tēs gēs diaspirenta, rhizoutai hōsper katabolades, kai epeita anistamena, kormon apotelei. ek de toutou palin kamphthenta kata ton auton tropon tēs auxēseōs, allēn katabolada poiei, kai epeita allēn, kai houtō kathexēs, hōste ex henos dendrou makran skian apoteleisthai,

eoikuian skēnē pollous kionas echousē. mnēmoneuei de kai tou megethous tōn dendrōn, phaskōn tous kormous tosoutous einai hōste pente andras molis perilambanein autous.
paraballe Aristoboulon, apospasma 30, hopou legetai hoti Aristoboulos periegraphē dendra tosoutou megethous hōste pentēkonta hippeis anapauesthai an hypo tē skia henos; Strabōn de prostithēsin: "houtos de (Onesikritos) tetrakosious phēsin." Nearchos, apospasma 40; Diodoros, biblion 17, kephalaion 90.

### 16.

Strabōn, biblion 15, selis 693: to de tous potamous hyperpleizein kai tous chersaious anemous mē pnein bebaioutai hypo tōn hypo Onesikritou legomenōn. phēsi gar tēn paralian tēs Indikēs helōdē einai, malista de kata tas tōn potamōn ekbolas, dia tēn ilyn, tas plēmmuras, kai tēn tōn thalassiōn anemōn epikrateian.
"ho de logos toutou tou apospasmatos bebaioutai ha hypo Aristoboulou peri tēs tōn Indikōn potamōn plēmmuras en tō 29 apospasmati diegēgēthē." — GEIER. hora katōterō, apospasma 20.

### 17.

Strabōn, biblion 15, selis 695: peri de toutou (tēs ennoias hoti to hydōr to ek tōn nephōn ēdē hephthon esti hotan ekcheētai), hoi peri Aristoboulon ouk an homologoien, phaskontes gar hyein epi tōn pediōn. Onesikritō de dokei touto to hydōr aition einai tōn en tois zōois phusikōn idiōmatōn. parechetai de tekmerion hoti ta tōn xenōn ktenōn chrōmata metaballei eis to epichōrion chrōma hotan pinōsin auto. touto men oun kalōs eirētai; ou mentoi eti orthōs poiei, tēn aitian tōn Aithiōpōn melainōn kai oulotrichōn ontōn haplōs eis to hydōr tithemenos, kai

oneidizei Theodektē tēn aitian eis auton ton hēlion anapemptonti, kathaper ekeinos ho syngrapheus phēsin:

kai toi Onesikritos an echoi tina logon; phēsi gar ton hēlion mēden enguterō einai tois Aithiōsin ē tois allois, alla mallon kata katheton epikeisthai kai dia touto mallon kaiein. houtō de phēsin ou kalōs eirēsthai ton hēlion "prosōrion" einai autois, epeidē ison diastēma pantōn esti. epicheirei de kai hoti hē thermotēs ouk aitia esti toiautēs katastaseōs, epeidē ouch houtōs echei tois en tē mētra, hous ho hēlios ou thigganei.
